name: Neem
plantSize: Typically grows up to 15–20 meters in height.
healthBenefits: Helps treat skin conditions like acne and eczema.
Boosts immunity and supports liver health.
Acts as a natural antimicrobial and detoxifying agent.

name: Aloe Vera
plantSize: Typically grows up to 60–100 cm in height.
requiredSoil: Well-drained sandy or cactus mix soil.
healthBenefits: Promotes wound healing and soothes burns.
Improves digestion and supports skin health.
Helps reduce inflammation and boosts hydration.

name: Camphor (Kapur)
plantSize: Derived from Cinnamomum camphora trees that grow up to 20–30 meters.
healthBenefits: Relieves pain, congestion, and cough.
Used in balms for muscle soreness and inflammation.
Acts as an antimicrobial and improves respiratory function.

name: Garlic
plantSize: Typically grows up to 30–60 cm in height.
healthBenefits: Boosts immunity and fights infections.
Improves heart health by lowering cholesterol and blood pressure.
Acts as an antioxidant and supports digestion.

name: Brahmi
plantSize: Typically grows up to 5–30 cm in height, creeping herb.
preferredClimate: Tropical and subtropical climates; moist areas.
requiredSoil: Moist, loamy soil; thrives near water.
healthBenefits: Improves memory, focus, and cognitive function.
Reduces anxiety and supports brain health.
Acts as an antioxidant and protects nerve cells.

name: Nagkesar
plantSize: Typically grows up to 20–30 meters in height.
healthBenefits: Helps treat fever, inflammation, and skin problems.
Supports digestion and improves appetite.
Acts as an antimicrobial and strengthens immunity.

name: Holy Basil (Tulsi)
plantSize: Typically grows up to 60 cm (2 feet) in height.
requiredSoil: Well-drained, fertile soil rich in organic matter.
healthBenefits: Helps in stress relief and supports immune function.
Promotes respiratory health and combats infections.
Acts as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant.

name: Ashwagandha
plantSize: Shrub growing 30 to 150 cm, with small red berry fruits.
requiredSoil: Well-drained sandy loam or loam soil, low to medium fertility.
healthBenefits: Reduces cortisol levels and helps manage chronic stress and anxiety.
Improves stamina, strength, and athletic endurance.
Supports thyroid function and hormonal balance.
Enhances memory and cognitive performance.

name: Turmeric (Haldi)
plantSize: Herbaceous perennial growing 60–90 cm with large oblong leaves.
preferredClimate: Warm, humid tropical climate with heavy rainfall.
requiredSoil: Well-drained loamy or alluvial soil, rich in organic matter.
healthBenefits: Powerful anti-inflammatory that rivals some pharmaceutical drugs without side effects.
Boosts brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF), protecting against Alzheimer's.
Supports liver detoxification and reduces risk of heart disease.
Used in AYUSH protocols for joint pain, arthritis, and wound healing.

name: Giloy (Guduchi)
plantSize: A large deciduous climbing shrub reaching 10–15 meters in length.
healthBenefits: Strengthens the immune system and fights chronic fever including dengue.
Helps regulate blood sugar levels in diabetic patients.
Reduces symptoms of gout, arthritis, and joint inflammation.
Acts as a powerful detoxifier that purifies blood.

name: Shatavari
plantSize: Climbing herb with spinous branches, reaching 1–2 meters.
preferredClimate: Tropical and subtropical; found from sea level to 1500m altitude.
requiredSoil: Well-drained sandy or gravelly soil, tolerates poor soils.
healthBenefits: Supports female reproductive health and hormonal balance across all life stages.
Promotes lactation and is widely used by nursing mothers.
Soothes gastrointestinal lining and treats ulcers and acid reflux.
Builds stamina and helps the body adapt to stress.

name: Moringa (Sahjan)
requiredSoil: Well-drained sandy or loamy soil; can tolerate poor soils.
healthBenefits: Called the Miracle Tree — leaves contain 7x the vitamin C of oranges and 4x the calcium of milk.
Lowers blood sugar and helps manage diabetes naturally.
Rich in iron, combats anemia and supports energy production.
Protects liver and supports detoxification of the body.

name: Ginger (Adrak)
plantSize: Herbaceous perennial growing 30–100 cm with reed-like stems.
preferredClimate: Warm, humid tropical and subtropical climates.
requiredSoil: Rich, well-drained loamy soil with high organic matter.
healthBenefits: Highly effective against all forms of nausea including morning sickness.
Reduces muscle pain and soreness after exercise.
Significantly lowers blood sugar and improves heart disease risk factors.
Treats chronic indigestion by accelerating emptying of the stomach.

name: Arjuna
plantSize: Large deciduous tree growing up to 20–25 meters with spreading crown.
preferredClimate: Tropical dry deciduous forests; moist, humid areas.
requiredSoil: Moist, well-drained alluvial soil near river banks.
healthBenefits: Strengthens heart muscles and treats angina, heart failure, and high blood pressure.
Lowers LDL cholesterol and regulates blood pressure naturally.
Protects the heart from oxidative stress and free radical damage.
Used in Ayurveda for over 2500 years as the premier cardiac herb.

name: Triphala
scientificName: Emblica officinalis + Terminalia bellirica + Terminalia chebula
plantSize: A traditional Ayurvedic formula combining three fruits: Amalaki, Bibhitaki, and Haritaki.
preferredClimate: Tropical and subtropical; each component tree has wide climate adaptability.
requiredSoil: Well-drained fertile soil; each component tree is drought-tolerant.
healthBenefits: Supports digestive health and relieves constipation gently without dependency.
One of the richest sources of Vitamin C; powerful immune booster.
Improves eye health and is used as an Ayurvedic eyewash.
Promotes healthy aging as a Rasayana — the cornerstone of Ayurvedic rejuvenation therapy.
